sar.narrative: Customer C01155, holder of card C01155-K2, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-11-29 and 2016-11-29, 1 transaction(s) totalling $100.08 were identified as unauthorised on that card, the earliest being transaction 3496768 and the transaction that triggered review being 3496768 for $100.08. The activity was conducted through the online channel in billing region 472.0. The transactions originated from device profile 'MacOS | Mac | safari generic | 1366x768', which the issuer's identity record marks 'Found' for this account, reached through an anonymous proxy. The purchases were made without the physical card, from a device with no prior history on the account. The same origin appears on 3 other card(s) belonging to unrelated customers within the same window, including C06544-K1, C08804-K1, C10137-K2, indicating a common actor across multiple cardholders rather than an isolated compromise. Closed investigation CC-3740 recorded confirmed fraud on comparable activity. The issuer assesses the probability of fraud at 0.80 on the evidence set out above. Total suspicious amount: $100.08.
